reference_authority.external_grade_policy: Preserve source, date, version and scope; missing institutional C/R grades remain unassessed.

required_evidence_scope: Target, requested capability and current/historical mode determine required fields; unrelated missing dimensions do not disable independent authorized analysis.

business_bands.label: 低
business_bands.condition: All target-required checks are complete with no applicable risk finding.

business_bands.label: 关注
business_bands.condition: Only a confirmed soft-goal warning applies; no unresolved review, hard block or required-check failure.

business_bands.label: 较高
business_bands.condition: An established acceptable-risk review or verified gradual-improvement exception applies.

business_bands.label: 高
business_bands.condition: A verified hard financial constraint is violated, or the diagnosed current portfolio has a known hard-limit breach.

business_bands.label: 未知
business_bands.condition: Required evidence is insufficient for a complete grade and no verified HIGH finding establishes a known high-risk lower bound.

not_applicable_policy: Explicitly record non-applicable checks, including investment ratios when all holdings are cash; do not divide by zero or equate missing values with zero.

aggregation.known_hard_financial_breach: HIGH only for independently validated evidence bound to the current target/task/plan/versions; when unrelated checks are incomplete, coverage remains PARTIAL and unknowns stay visible.
aggregation.required_information_missing_without_kno: UNKNOWN; business information to supply is REVIEW, malformed input or failed required computation is ERROR.
aggregation.industry_unknown_exception: ELEVATED/PARTIAL/REVIEW only when R05 explicitly permits the bounded uncertainty; not permission to hide known breaches or assert improvement.
aggregation.full_evidence_with_reviews: ELEVATED; keep review reasons and recovery type.
aggregation.full_evidence_with_only_confirmed_soft_g: NOTICE; no change to existing hard or review rules.
aggregation.diagnosis_is_not_execution_gate: An existing breach may be diagnosed as HIGH while risk_decision is null because no execution check was requested. Proposed plans are checked separately.
aggregation.permission_denied_before_engine: Do not run financial checks or fabricate an Engine BLOCK; risk_decision=null, engine_ran=false, band=UNKNOWN.
aggregation.known_block_plus_check_error: Keep the verified BLOCK and HIGH lower-bound finding with PARTIAL coverage and separate check_errors; execution stays prohibited. If no hard block can be established, required-check failure is ERROR and UNKNOWN.

financial_thresholds.decision_precision: Compare unrounded ratios with a common documented numeric precision; display rounding does not affect decisions.
financial_thresholds.total_assets_definition: Non-cash market value plus ledger cash at one valuation time, with the cash basis explicitly recorded.
financial_thresholds.industry_policy: Use all known direct-stock exposure plus versioned ETF industry weights; unknown exposure stays separate. Cash and non-equity exposure are not forced into stock industries.

cashflow_policy.conversion: Exact decimal CNY yuan to safe integer fen; validate already-minor amounts without multiplying again.
cashflow_policy.protected_unreserved_formula: For each unique unpaid protected obligation, subtract only its amount not already covered by an active linked hold.
cashflow_policy.already_paid_or_included_items: Do not deduct obligations already paid/reflected in the snapshot, duplicate events, or a protected amount already covered by the same hold.
cashflow_policy.future_income: Keep expected income in an explicitly projected timeline; do not increase current available cash until the trusted ledger confirms arrival. Never add salary already included in the snapshot.
cashflow_policy.time_axis: Evaluate cash and confirmed obligations in due-date order, keeping source timezones and dates; do not imply that later cash cures an earlier shortfall.
cashflow_policy.unknown_values: Preserve unknown facts; do not infer zero, currency, payment completion, account version or authorization from dataset examples.

fixed_rules.requirement: Registered action scope, resource ownership, untrusted-data isolation and real-execution prohibition.
Validate required source, time, type, units, versions and reproducible calculations; keep missing facts distinct from errors.
Trusted available cash, sellable holdings, confirmed additional reserve, protected purposes and allowed assets must satisfy the plan; references do not supply the user's actual constraints.
Single and top-three ratios checked under both denominators using retained demo thresholds; only a validated gradual-improvement exception may become REVIEW.
Check every known industry under both denominators; missing classification may use only the explicit uncertainty review exception, never override a known breach.
Historical drawdown greater than the user's confirmed comparison reference requires REVIEW; not a future loss guarantee.
Any aligned-return pair with correlation >=0.8 and combined total-assets weight >0.40 requires REVIEW.
Verified final-user approval binds the complete current plan and relevant versions; it never overwrites financial hard blocks.
Idempotent outcome, changed-body conflict rejection, UNKNOWN reconciliation and trusted reservation lifecycle.
Persist minimal execution intent and linked results, rejection, revocation and recovery; pre-write audit failure stops writes.

state_boundaries.callback_error_behavior: Do not submit a business decision callback; persist an error and retain execution closure.
state_boundaries.new_bands_stored_as: Internal assessment/audit sidecar until the architecture and Core Owners accept a versioned extension.

release_conditions: Architecture Owner freezes contexts and a single gateway with same-task bindings.
Identity and approval Owners provide authenticated final-user approval and revocation/commit ordering.
Finance provides the unique hosted ledger, account versions, atomic reserve/commit/release and reconciliation.
Quant validates market metadata, metric formulas, windows and ETF industry evidence.
Vesper and all Owners verify positive, boundary, negative and failure cases on the same staging deployment.
